name: powershell-test-runner

storage.rationale: PowerShell jobs are host-session state; the runner owns their lifetime and Vrooli does not persist tool data.

description: Windows PowerShell job runner for shell and lifecycle tests
installHint: Install PowerShell 7 from the Microsoft.PowerShell winget package.

linux.evidence: The Windows PowerShell job peer is not the Linux test runner.

macos.evidence: The Windows PowerShell job peer is not the macOS test runner.
